_readme: Ambience settings. Volume is in dB: -6 is about half as loud, -12 a quarter, +3 a little louder. Every track is first evened out to the same loudness, then volumeDb (all rooms) and the room's gainDb are added. A change here needs a restart: systemctl restart supporters. A swapped sound file needs none.
_enabled: false turns all ambience off (AMBIENCE=off in .env does the same and wins).
_volumeDb: Every room at once. 0 is the normal level.
_leaveDelaySeconds: How long a helper stays after the last person leaves.
_rooms: One entry per room. key: the room's name and its sound file (audio/<key>.mp3, or a folder audio/<key>/ for a random track). match: words looked for in the voice channel's name, ignoring case, spaces and emoji. channelId: use exactly this channel instead (right-click the channel > Copy Channel ID). gainDb: this room only, added to volumeDb. status: the line under the channel name. visual and caption: a GIF from assets/visuals/<visual>.gif posted in the room's chat with this text, or null for none. To silence one room, delete its sound file or point it at no channel. To add a room, add an entry with a new key and put audio/<key>.mp3 in place.
